central_idea: Combine an LLM with chemistry-specific computational tools and robotic synthesis access.
representation_or_method: Iterative GPT-4 tool requests followed by observations; 18 tools in reported system.
task_or_domain: Chemistry reasoning, synthesis and materials tasks.
evidence_or_evaluation: Physical synthesis examples and expert/LLM assessments across use cases.
main_limitations: Capabilities depend on expert tools; public implementation exposes only 12 of 18 tools and relies on proprietary model access.
project_relevance: Makes tool quality and integration burden visible beneath apparent agent autonomy.

title: A mobile robotic chemist
central_idea: Use a mobile manipulator to run experiment batches and choose new formulations from measured outcomes.
representation_or_method: Batched Bayesian search coupled to mobile robot laboratory operations.
evidence_or_evaluation: Author abstract reports 688 experiments over eight days in a ten-variable search.
main_limitations: Purpose-built laboratory procedure; abstract does not establish arbitrary task teaching or general instrument operation.
project_relevance: Shows useful autonomous experimental work can arise without an LLM.

title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
central_idea: Use literature-derived recipes and thermodynamics-informed active learning to run and interpret robotic synthesis.
representation_or_method: Natural-language recipe models, experiment automation and measurement-driven optimization.
evidence_or_evaluation: Corrected abstract reports 36 compounds from 57 targets during 17 days.
main_limitations: 2026 correction revises novelty interpretation and excludes inconclusive diffraction identifications plus a training-data overlap.
project_relevance: Strong example of why automated execution and claimed scientific discovery require independent evidence checks.

sources.material_reviewed: Indexed corrected abstract, title, metadata and correction notice.
Complete Author Correction body describing novelty clarification, reanalysis, four inconclusive identifications and one training-data overlap.

metadata_notes: Original 2023-11-29 title used 'novel materials'; current corrected title uses 'inorganic materials'. Correction published 2026-01-19, DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-09992-y. Authors shortened.

robotics_context.execution_loop: Recipe proposal -> robotic synthesis -> characterization -> active-learning revision.
robotics_context.transfer_limits: Specialized materials infrastructure; synthesis success is separate from material novelty.
robotics_context.reuse_and_licensing: Artifact licenses not inspected; article access alone does not establish reuse permission.
